name: agentic-knowledge-graph
description: Local development commands only. Not a build manifest: each portal and service owns its dependencies and deploys independently. Three tiers -- containers, middleware, ui -- each with start-all / stop-all / status-all. Containers are started once; middleware and ui are restarted as you work, which is what local:restart-all does.

scripts.local:all:restart-all: npm run local:all:stop-all; npm run local:all:start-all
scripts.local:all:start-all: npm run local:containers:start-all && npm run local:middleware:start-all && npm run local:ui:start-all
scripts.local:all:status-all: npm run local:containers:status-all; npm run local:middleware:status-all; npm run local:ui:status-all
scripts.local:all:stop-all: npm run local:ui:stop-all; npm run local:middleware:stop-all; npm run local:containers:stop-all
scripts.local:containers:restart-all: npm run local:containers:stop-all; npm run local:containers:start-all
scripts.local:contracts:test: uv run --directory Libraries/python/akg-contracts --with pydantic --with pytest python -m pytest -q
scripts.local:db:restart: docker restart akg-postgres && npm run local:db:migrate
scripts.local:middleware:restart-all: npm run local:middleware:stop-all; npm run local:middleware:start-all
scripts.local:restart-all: npm run local:middleware:stop-all; npm run local:ui:stop-all; npm run local:middleware:start-all && npm run local:ui:start-all
scripts.local:stop-all: npm run local:ui:stop-all; npm run local:middleware:stop-all
scripts.local:ui:restart-all: npm run local:ui:stop-all; npm run local:ui:start-all
